exposure.needed: whether the environment carries custom Kafka logging configuration in the Reload4j/Log4j1 format, and whether it runs/upgrades to Kafka 4.0 or newer

consequence.statement: If the operator does nothing, custom Kafka logging configuration written for Reload4j/Log4j1 may no longer be honoured under Kafka 4.0's Log4j2 logging; the changelog says it might need to be updated during the upgrade to Kafka 4.0.
consequence.remediation: Update custom Kafka logging configuration to the Log4j2 format during the upgrade to Kafka 4.0.

assertion.statement: Kafka 4.0 and newer uses Log4j2 for logging instead of Reload4j/Log4j1, so any custom logging configuration might need to be updated during the upgrade to Kafka 4.0.
